title: Egyptian Chicken Curry
description: A flavorful and aromatic French-inspired curry dish made with tender chicken and a blend of traditional Egyptian spices.
instructions: Heat the coconut oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chopped onion and sauté until translucent, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and sauté for another minute.
Add the chicken breast and cook until browned on all sides, about 5-6 minutes.
Add the curry powder, cumin, coriander, salt, and black pepper. Stir to combine.
Add the chicken broth and bring the mixture to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to medium-low and let the curry simmer for 15-20 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
